intro: Trapped indoors by aggressive prowling predators, Deathstalker Erland requires an escort through Silverpine Forest to regroup with his partner. Assisting him safely across the wilderness delivers him directly to Deathstalker Rane Yorick.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door. They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.
I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick. And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.
Please escort me! And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please be brief. There is much danger about and we cannot stand idle in conversation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for the aid, friend. I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine. With your help, I see that he has not.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
